context.purpose: Explain correlated multi-channel numeric measurements with centred, explicitly scaled principal components, labelled loadings/scores or a retained-subspace projector, explained variance and a reconstruction in channel units.
context.assumptions: Arithmetic mean centring, n-1 denominator, declared scaling (none needs one shared unit), parsed binary64 data; isolated NumPy 2.5.4 with OpenBLAS 0.3.34 on POSIX, one thread.
context.constraints: 2-32 channels, 3-10000 rows, 160000 cells, 8 MiB ASCII CSV, at most 10 components; raw values zero or within [1e-48,1e48]; offset ratio <=1e6; scaled spread within [1e-48,1e48]; every published value within +/-1e100.
context.inspection: Inspect spectrum/loadings/scores or projector/reconstruction CSVs and pca-verification.json, the host record of a posteriori loading/subspace bounds, certification ratios, effective tolerances and requirement statuses.
context.recovery: Correct located contract/CSV/range/scaling faults; repeated spectra need subspace output or other retention; uncertified reconstructions need standardise or less extreme scales; unmet/indeterminate requirements are retained evidence, not accepted results.

workflow.scope: Verified table artifacts hand off by index; only accepted runs (requirements met) can be consumed.

composition.scope: Shared references, expressions and finite studies resolve to the same literal PCA contract.

lifecycle.timeout: Single total deadline (default 120 s) over host validation, both native stages and host verification; native CPU 60 s, address space 4 GiB, 64 MiB per file.
lifecycle.cancellation: Owned process-group cancellation through the shared runner and a pre-publication check.
lifecycle.logs: Captured CSV, authored/plan/native configuration, worker and implementation fingerprints, consumed-input bindings, submissions, stdout/stderr, native fault records and readback record.
lifecycle.verification: Independent standard-library oracle: strict CSV grammar, fsum statistics, cyclic Jacobi spectrum with residual-based eigenvalue bounds, Davis-Kahan loading and subspace bounds, Eckart-Young residual and host-owned requirement/certification decisions recomputed by saved verification.

losses: Decimal text is parsed to binary64; no quotes, missing values, dates or text columns.
data.scope: Regular local capture <=8 MiB; complete host validation before native launch.

losses: Eigenvalue accuracy is relative to total variance only.
data.scope: All p eigenvalues of the n-1 covariance of the scaled data.

losses: Rank-K approximation; certified per channel to <= loadingTolerance x sample deviation.
